name: The Park Avenue Grey Three-Piece Wool Suit
description:
Crafted for discerning gentlemen seeking absolute distinction, The Park Avenue Grey Three-Piece Wool Suit embodies the pinnacle of Park Avenue sartorial excellence. Cut from pristine Super 150s Italian Virgin Wool (Biella, Italy) woven with a 280g/m four-season weight, offering fluid drape, natural thermal balance, and resilient shape retention., each jacket features a full-canvas chest piece that molds naturally to the wearer's anatomy over time, creating a bespoke drape unmatched by ready-to-wear alternatives.

Hand-finished with subtle pick-stitching along the lapels, genuine horn buttons, and functional sleeve cuffs, this two-piece ensemble effortlessly commands boardroom presentations, diplomatic galas, and high-stakes social occasions across the United States. The trousers feature a refined mid-rise cut, curtain waistband, and pick-stitched slant pockets for unwavering comfort and structural poise.
fabric: Super 150s Italian Virgin Wool (Biella, Italy) woven with a 280g/m four-season weight, offering fluid drape, natural thermal balance, and resilient shape retention.
